meta.title: Alien Sex Clone
meta.author: Simon (Fudge)
meta.description: The soundtrack of Alien Sex Clone, Fudge's 64K intro that won the PC 64K intro competition at The Party 1998 (pouet 444, Demozoo 21494). Music by Simon (Demozoo 21494); Demozoo music 202313, "Alien Seckse Clone (final version)", credits Echo and Simn, and its XM shares the order list and 86 % of the note cells with this one. 4:17, 47 phrase, 5 stored tracks. This is an adapted version, not the original recording. The intro synthesizes 22 of its 25 samples at start-up with two generators of its own, a sine tone with a two-stage shaper and a sine drum with an accelerating sweep; here each is a live unified-synth oscillator (Shaper tone, Sweep drum: the generators' own arguments, read from the running original by tools/xm-gen), and the three samples the intro keeps as PCM play on a sampler (GSM-encoded). `synth-convert xm` replays the XM into notes and per-tick automation (volume, pan, pitch slides), mixed as OpenMPT mixes this file (it takes it for ModPlug Tracker 1.0-1.16: a linear pan law); `song import` cuts the lanes into patterns. Every generated sample matches the original's within one step of 16 bits; against the OpenMPT render of the original XM it is within 0.2 dB loudness and 0.7 dB per octave band (tools/unisynth-parity/plain-xm.ts). Track names are derived here from the XM instrument and the speed class, not the author's. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
